maskLifecyclePatch: Local AlphaMaskEffect reset clears its completed mask source before pool reuse. This separate lifecycle fix does not claim upstream proposal coverage.
renderTargetLifecyclePatch: Local RenderTargetSystem cleanup removes only its own source destroy callbacks. Source destruction retains target cleanup and removes the callback registry entry. This separate fix does not claim upstream proposal coverage or native heap acceptance.
graphicsBatchReusePatch: Local GraphicsContextSystem bind-group preparation visits only the current batch count, not stale array tails retained by pooled render data. This separate lifecycle fix does not claim upstream proposal coverage or native remount acceptance.
